summary: A Mayfair address and named agents with client testimonials are strengths, but an empty Residences section, no contact form and an old press section appear to cost you prime enquiries.

findings.problem: The Residences heading has only a View All Properties link with no listings, and Development says VIEW PROJECTS but shows no projects.
findings.cost: A prime agency page with no properties shown gives buyers nothing to act on.
findings.fix: Featured properties and projects on the homepage.

findings.problem: No contact form appears, only an email and a phone number, and the footer phone link is written tel:+44\(0\)2076594425.
findings.cost: Vendors who want to enquire online have no simple option and the call link may fail.
findings.fix: A direct valuation and enquiry form with a tested call link.

findings.problem: Two Thomas Cubitt press items cover the same story, one slug reads 1095mn while the headline says 5 million, and the press items date from 2024.
findings.cost: Duplicate and mismatched press items make the proof look stale.

findings.problem: The page shows 'successful out-come', 'straight forward' twice, and testimonials from Mr. S, Mr. S and Mr. R with no dates or transaction details.
findings.cost: Typos and anonymous testimonials weaken trust with high value vendors.

redesign: Featured properties and projects on the homepage.
A valuation and enquiry form with WhatsApp and a tested call link.
Current press, proofread copy and verifiable testimonials.
